themes.name: Agentic AI in research
themes.description: Covers AI agents that can perform research tasks autonomously, make decisions, and interact with systems to achieve research goals.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Focuses on AI tools that assist developers with writing, debugging, and analyzing code.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: Encompasses a broad range of AI-powered platforms and software designed to support and enhance the research process.

themes.name: AI summarization
themes.description: Deals with AI applications that condense large amounts of text, data, or research into concise summaries and key insights.

themes.name: AI chatbot research
themes.description: Explores the use, impact, and research findings related to AI-powered chatbots, including their user interactions and potential biases.

themes.name: AI design research
themes.description: Covers the application of AI in the design process, including AI-assisted design tools, prototyping, and generative design.

themes.name: Synthetic users
themes.description: Focuses on the creation and use of AI-generated personas or user simulations for testing and research purposes.

themes.name: AI for product management
themes.description: Highlights how AI is being used to inform product decisions, manage roadmaps, and analyze product performance.

themes.name: AI workforce impact
themes.description: Examines the effects of AI on employment, job roles, skills, and the future of work across various industries.

themes.name: AI testing automation
themes.description: Details AI's role in automating software testing, quality assurance, and validation processes.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
